meta.notes: Input: 28x28 averaged in 4x4 blocks to 7x7, 0 = paper, 1 = ink. Hidden: sigmoid. Output: softmax, cross-entropy loss. Training: full-batch gradient descent on all 60,000 training digits; step 1 uses firstStepLearningRate (too big on purpose, the loss rises), then learningRate. Valley: loss over the plane of the top-2 principal directions of the weight trajectory is replaced by a ribbon: each row is a real point on the training path (rowStep), each column steps sideways along one fixed random direction (seed seedWall), loss on all 60,000 training digits; the middle column is exactly the training loss.
